Name: The High Places of Baal
Flavor Text: The people forsook the Lord and served the Baals.
Effect: Any Faith spent this round counts as only half Influence on the Moral Track (round down).

Name: Midianite Swarms
Flavor Text: They came like locusts… and left no sustenance in Israel.
Effect: The Provision Track threshold is increased by 1 this round.

Name: Iron Chariots of the North
Flavor Text: Sisera had nine hundred iron chariots…
Effect: Military Track tokens cost 1 extra Warrior to place this round (or count as –1 Influence if you cannot pay).

Name: The Cry of the Oppressed
Flavor Text: The people of Israel cried out to the Lord…
Effect: The first player to become Champion of any track this round gains +1 Faith.

Name: Abimelech’s Ambition
Flavor Text: He hired worthless and reckless fellows…
Effect: At the end of the round, the player with the most Glory loses 1 Loyalty (ties = all tied players lose 1).

Name: The Ammonite Claim
Effect: Military and Moral Tracks both require +1 total Influence to succeed this round.

Name: Micah’s Idol
Flavor Text: Every man did what was right in his own eyes.
Effect: Players may not spend Faith on tribe unique actions this round.

Name: The Philistine Razor
Flavor Text: The Philistines came up and encamped in Judah…
Effect: Any player who becomes Military Champion must immediately lose 1 Warrior or 1 Goods.

Name: Jephthah’s Vow
Flavor Text: Whatever comes out from the doors of my house…
Effect: If the Moral Track fails this round, the Covenant Meter drops an extra 1. If it succeeds, the Champion gains +1 Glory.

Name: The Levite’s Concubine
Flavor Text: Such a thing has never happened or been seen…
Effect: All Loyalty losses this round are increased by 1. (Stand Firm and similar protections still work.)

Name: Civil Strife in Benjamin
Flavor Text: There was a very great slaughter…
Effect: After Champions are determined, the two players with the highest total Influence on the Military Track each lose 1 Loyalty.

Name: The Angel of the Lord
Flavor Text: I brought you up from Egypt… but you have not obeyed my voice.
Effect: Look at the top two cards of the Crisis deck. Put one on top and one on the bottom. Then raise or lower the Covenant Meter by 1 (your choice).

Name: The Day of Midian
Flavor Text: The sword of the Lord and of Gideon!
Effect: Military Track fails automatically unless the total Influence on it is at least double the normal threshold. If it succeeds, every player who invested at least 1 token gains +1 Glory.

Name: In Those Days There Was No King
Flavor Text: …everyone did what was right in his own eyes.
Effect: At the end of the round the Covenant Meter drops by 1 automatically, regardless of track results. In addition, no player may gain more than 1 Glory from Champion rewards this round.
